title_en: Application for the Asia K-Banker School for Government-Invited International Scholars
summary: Government-invited international scholarship students who wish to take part in the Asia K-Banker School, hosted by KB Kookmin Bank and Bapilkkum, may apply. Applications must be submitted online through a Google Form by 24:00 on Tuesday, 24 November 2026. All events are held in Korean, and details are in the attachment to the original notice.
applies_to: Government-invited international scholarship students (정부초청외국인장학생) who wish to participate. Participation is voluntary; the notice does not state that it is mandatory. Applicants with TOPIK Level 4 or higher and applicants majoring in finance, economics or business-related fields are given preference.

dates.what: Operating hours of the Asia K-Banker School Operations Office for inquiries

conditions: Applications must be submitted by 24:00 on Tuesday, 24 November 2026.
Applications are submitted online through a Google Form.
Applicants with TOPIK Level 4 or higher are given preference.
Applicants majoring in finance, economics or business-related fields are given preference.
All events, including lectures and discussions, are conducted in Korean.
steps: Read the attachment to the original notice (2026_Asia_K-Banker_School_안내_261030 (1).hwpx) for program details and the application method; its content was not read for this translation.
Complete and submit the online application form (Google Form) by 24:00 on Tuesday, 24 November 2026; the form link is not given in the notice text, so check the attachment.
For questions, contact the Asia K-Banker School Operations Office between 10:00 and 18:00; the email address and phone number are in the original notice.
translation:
Government-Invited International Scholars: Application for the 「Asia K-Banker School」

We announce the 「Asia K-Banker School」 program, hosted by KB Kookmin Bank and Bapilkkum (a nonprofit incorporated association), as follows.

A. Program name: Asia K-Banker School
   - Digital finance as seen through the eyes of Asian international students

B. Application period: until Tuesday, 24 November 2026, 24:00

C. Application method: submit the online application form (Google Form) / check the attachment

E. Details: see the [attachment]

F. Notes for applicants
   - Preference is given to applicants with TOPIK Level 4 or higher and to applicants majoring in finance, economics or business-related fields.
   - All events (lectures and discussions) are conducted in Korean.

G. Inquiries: Asia K-Banker School Operations Office (operating hours 10:00–18:00)
   - Email and phone: see the original notice.

Attachment (1)
2026_Asia_K-Banker_School_안내_261030 (1).hwpx (78 KB) — the content of this attachment was not read for this translation.

(Note: item D is missing from the numbering in the original notice.)
